title: Ship It: an iPhone idle tycoon about building apps, automating a studio and making your exit
author: HHendrik
selftext:
Hey folks! I made Ship It, an idle tycoon where you start as a solo app developer and build a portfolio of earning apps.

The loop is code → ship → upgrade → automate → sell the studio. Old apps keep earning while you build the next one, and selling your studio gives you permanent bonuses for the next run. There are collectible tech-world advisers with passive perks and timed boosts, plus a pixel-art office that grows along the way.

It's on iPhone (iOS 17+), free with optional purchases, rewarded ads and a Founder Club subscription. The core game is playable without purchases or ads. Away earnings have a cap.

I'd love feedback on the progression: does your first studio sale feel like a satisfying milestone, and does the next run give you enough reason to keep going?

[https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ship-it-idle-dev-tycoon/id6809817246](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ship-it-idle-dev-tycoon/id6809817246)

Let me know what you think :)

Rik

comments.author: java1450
comments.body:
Interesting idea. But why not follow the other idle gameplay uis. Feel like its more engaging when people upgrade things visually.

Like having buildings. Ceo office, r&d department etc. Makes the gameplay more interactive.
